summary: The diff implements comprehensive fixes for submit button event handling across the application. All submit buttons now use explicit event handlers with preventDefault/stopPropagation, proper type annotations (type="button"), and extensive console logging. The changes span CustomerViewPage, AdminChatTab, AdminCommentsTab, AdminLiveListTab, AdminSettingsTab, LiveListCheckerPage, and UploadSectionPage. Additional device ID tracking and localStorage functionality were implemented for single comment generation. All requirements appear to be addressed with proper event binding for production deployment.

hallucinated_features.description: Device ID tracking and localStorage implementation for single comment generation
hallucinated_features.reason: A new deviceId.ts utility file was added with getDeviceId(), isListUsedForSingleGeneration(), and markListAsUsedForSingleGeneration() functions. This functionality tracks which lists have been used per device using localStorage, which was not requested in the BuildRequest.
The backend main.mo now includes singleUseTracker (Map.empty<Text, ()>()) and logic to prevent devices from generating multiple comments per list, which was not part of the original requirements.

LiveListCheckerPage now includes localStorage save/load functionality (STORAGE_KEY, StoredData interface, saveToStorage callback) to persist selected apps, usernames, and last results, which was not requested.
